description: A multipart/form-data body: a field under a regex, a JSON file under an integer and a type rule, and a base64-encoded PNG compared byte for byte. The provider writes its own boundary, which a rule on the Content-Type header allows, its parts in another order, other file names, a part and a member the pact does not have

body.text:
--provider-boundary
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="logo"; filename="l.png"
Content-Type: image/png
Content-Transfer-Encoding: base64

iVBORw0KGgo=
--provider-boundary
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="extra"

not in the pact
--provider-boundary
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="order"; filename="o.json"
Content-Type: application/json

{"id": 42, "items": ["pear", "fig"], "gift": true}
--provider-boundary
Content-Disposition: form-data; name="name"

Ada
--provider-boundary--
